mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint rise in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signals a monetary tightening cycle coinciding with labor market deterioration, which compresses corporate profit margins and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails to materialize in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, characterized by elevated housing starts, the S&P 500 typically delivers positive forward returns as the economy nears its peak, reflecting strong consumer demand and corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods classified as late-cycle expansion (HOUST > 2200), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 2000 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the residential construction sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 2000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, as indicated by a sustained rise in the federal funds rate, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to higher borrowing costs and reduced liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods classified as monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in housing starts and industrial production signals a broad-based economic slowdown, reducing corporate revenue growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails to materialize in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
